moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Starts
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21, 2026, with fixtures released on June 19, 2026.

angles.name: Countdown to Kick-off
angles.copy: Only 10 days until the Premier League returns! Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Fantasy Football Prep
angles.copy: Getting your fantasy football team ready? The Premier League starts August 21st, so get those transfers in!

moments.title: Community Shield: Man City vs Arsenal
moments.blurb: Manchester City, the FA Cup holders, face Premier League champions Arsenal in the Community Shield at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosting
angles.copy: Football fever hits Cardiff this Sunday! Manchester City take on Arsenal in the Community Shield at Principality Stadium. Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Early Season Clash
angles.copy: Man City vs Arsenal – a taste of things to come? The Community Shield this Sunday is set to be a cracker. Tune in for all the action!

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Ongoing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is in full swing until August 31, 2026, offering thousands of shows across comedy, theatre, music, and more.

angles.name: Fringe Frenzy
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is delivering daily doses of incredible talent, from stand-up to experimental theatre. What's been your highlight so far?

angles.name: Experience Edinburgh
angles.copy: Comedy, drama, music, dance – the Edinburgh Fringe has it all until August 31st! If you're in Scotland, don't miss out on the action.

moments.title: Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo Live
moments.blurb: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo continues its spectacular run at Edinburgh Castle until August 29, 2026, featuring music, dance, and military displays.

angles.name: Castle Spectacle

angles.name: A Call to Gather
angles.copy: This year's Tattoo theme, 'A Call to Gather', is bringing friends and kindred spirits together for an unforgettable experience. Running until Aug 29!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31, 2026, marking the last long weekend of summer.

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Don't forget, the August Bank Holiday is on Monday, August 31st! Make the most of it before autumn kicks in.

moments.title: UK School Summer Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: Schools across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland remain on summer break, with most returning in early September, while Scottish schools are resuming this week.
